thought.text: I found the issue — the file needs to be named `webapps.properties` (plural), but I created it as `webapp.properties`. I'll rename it and update the Dockerfile accordingly.

reasoning_content:
Found it! The correct filename is **`webapps.properties`** (plural "webapps"), NOT `webapp.properties` (singular). Let me check:

From the guide:
> For the Tomcat instance *Dienste-Tomcat*, a *webapp.properties* file must be created.
> **Example of *webapps.properties* for the *Dienste-Tomcat*:**

The guide itself has a contradiction: the body says `webapp.properties`, but the example heading says `webapps.properties`. The actual code / Dockerfile uses `webapps.properties` (plural). In other words, the guide's body is slightly wrong (or the two names refer to the same thing), and the correct name is `webapps.properties`.

Let me rename the file and also check the contents of the webapps.properties used in the Dockerfile to verify the exact format.

action.command: cat /workspace/xplan-webservices/xplan-webservices-services/xplan-services-wfs/webapps.properties 2>/dev/null; echo ===; cat /workspace/xplan-webservices/xplan-webservices-services/xplan-services-wms/webapps.properties 2>/dev/null; echo ===; mv /opt/deegree/webapp.properties /opt/deegree/webapps.properties; ls /opt/deegree/webapps.properties
